==Summary==

{{pov|[[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]}}

Cadsuane is eavesdropping on [[Sarene Nemdahl]] as she interrogates [[Semirhage]] and still frustrated over the lack of progress in breaking her. She considers once again how she would break herself. Semirhage knocks her noon meal, a plate of beans, onto the floor. Cadsuane realizes that she has to humiliate Semirhage to break her spirit, so she knocks her food to the floor, puts her over her knee and begins to spank Semirhage. She has the other Sisters come in to watch as well as some of the servants. Extreme threats from the Forsaken ensue but Cadsuane ignores them. She continues the humiliating spanking until Semirhage finally eats the beans off the floor. She has found a way to break her.

{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

Perrin is worried over the logistics of bringing a hundred thousand refugees home. [[Neald]] and [[Grady]] are too tired to make [[Gateways]]. It would take days to send home the people that are willing to leave and they can't hold a Gateway for more than an hour until they are rested, so they continue north by foot. Perrin ponders his bond to the wolves and remembers how close he came to killing [[Hopper]] in the [[wolf dream]]. He wonders if his fate will be the same as a Wolf brother he freed long ago that had lost all of his humanity. He decides it is time to return to the wolf dream and stop evading his responsibilities.
